units.source_text: 我和荣吉找了一个貌似无赖的男子带了一程路，到了一家旅店，据说店主是前镇长。

en.t: Eikichi and I found a man who looked like a ruffian to guide us for part of the way, and we arrived at an inn whose owner was said to be the former town mayor.

units.source_text: 浴罢，我和荣吉一起吃了午饭，菜肴中有新上市的鱼。

en.t: After bathing, Eikichi and I ate lunch together, and among the dishes was fish newly in season.
